nodes.description: IAddressProvider state variable `a`, the protocol address provider used by LiquidationManager to reach config() and the collateral configuration.
Constant 1e18 threshold; health factors below it mean the vault is liquidatable.
LiquidationManager constructor: requires _addresses != address(0) and stores it as the address provider `a`.
public view override isHealthy(_collateralValue,_vaultDebt,_minRatio): delegates to calculateHealthFactor and compares the result with HEALTH_FACTOR_LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD.

public view override calculateHealthFactor(...): computes collateralizationRatio = collateralValue.wadDiv(vaultDebt), then healthFactor = collateralizationRatio.wadDiv(minRatio); returns 1e18 when debt is zero or minRatio is zero.
public view override applyLiquidationDiscount(_collateralType,_amount): returns _amount.wadDiv(bonus + WAD) where bonus is read from a.config().
Implicit external caller; every public function of LiquidationManager is reachable by any msg.sender.
WadRayMath.wadDiv arithmetic used twice in calculateHealthFactor (collateralValue/vaultDebt and collateralizationRatio/minRatio).
External contract call a.config().collateralLiquidationBonus(_collateralType) reaching the address provider and config provider.
Local variable healthFactor holding the value returned by calculateHealthFactor inside isHealthy.

edges.reason: Constructor stores the _addresses argument into state variable a.
isHealthy forwards _collateralValue to calculateHealthFactor.
isHealthy forwards _vaultDebt to calculateHealthFactor.
isHealthy forwards _minRatio to calculateHealthFactor.
Caller-supplied _collateralValue becomes calculateHealthFactor's argument.
Caller-supplied _vaultDebt becomes calculateHealthFactor's argument.
Caller-supplied _minRatio becomes calculateHealthFactor's argument.
_collateralValue is used inside calculateHealthFactor.
_vaultDebt is used inside calculateHealthFactor.
_minRatio is used inside calculateHealthFactor.

_vaultDebt is the divisor in collateralizationRatio = _collateralValue.wadDiv(_vaultDebt).
_minRatio is the divisor in healthFactor = collateralizationRatio.wadDiv(_minRatio).
calculateHealthFactor performs unchecked-style wadDiv arithmetic on user-controlled values.
Return value of calculateHealthFactor is assigned to the healthFactor local variable in isHealthy.
healthFactor is compared against HEALTH_FACTOR_LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD.
HEALTH_FACTOR_LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD is read by isHealthy for the >= comparison.

_amount is the value used to compute the bonus in liquidationBonus.
_collateralType is forwarded to the external call a.config().collateralLiquidationBonus(...).
liquidationBonus triggers an external call into the config provider through a.config().
_amount is multiplied by the collateral liquidation bonus using wadMul.
liquidationBonus performs wadMul arithmetic with the externally supplied bonus value.
_collateralType selects the bonus used in applyLiquidationDiscount.
_amount is the balance on which applyLiquidationDiscount operates.
_collateralType is forwarded to the external call a.config().collateralLiquidationBonus(...).
applyLiquidationDiscount triggers an external call into the config provider through a.config().
_amount flows into the wadDiv denominator (bonus + WAD) computation.
applyLiquidationDiscount performs add/wadDiv arithmetic on user-controlled values.
State variable a is dereferenced to obtain the config used by liquidationBonus.
State variable a is dereferenced to obtain the config used by applyLiquidationDiscount.

_minRatio is a call-scoped parameter of isHealthy and carries no standalone semantics.
